resources.string: Replies and quote tweets in your recent tweet sample, relative to recorded views. Counts are cumulative, not unique people.
Compare median views for text, image and video tweets of similar age. Shown when there is enough comparable data.
Compare your net follower change over the latest recorded week with the previous week.
Your recorded follower change and a sample of tweets published in the past week. View counts are lifetime totals.
See which recurring hashtags have higher median views than other tweets of similar age. Based on your sample, not predicted trends.
A format to try based on your recent content patterns. Compare the next tweet at a similar age; results are not guaranteed.
